comment: mthrowu.c thrwmm() 997-1001: a pet archer whose crossbow and bolts are ready lines up with a monster farther than PET_MISSILE_RANGE2 (dist2 > 36), so thrwmm() returns M_ATTK_MISS without shooting (1001). A debug Valkyrie creates three peaceful cockatrices (pets never melee them) and four tame plains centaurs (half get a crossbow and bolts, makemon.c m_initweap); after she walks west the centaurs wield crossbows, shoot at cockatrices within range and once find one 7 squares away in a straight line.
